basic_info.name: Secureframe
basic_info.description: Secureframe is an award-winning security and compliance automation platform trusted by organizations ranging from startups and SMBs to contractors across the defense industrial base, including Nasdaq, Fivetran, Base Power, Hawkeye360, and OpenEvidence. Through 400+ integrations with platforms like Microsoft GCC High, Azure Government, AWS GovCloud, and Google Workspace, Secureframe uses AI to automatically collect and verify audit evidence, monitor security controls, and generate critical documentation like SSPs and POA&Ms. Teams use Secureframe to stay assessment-ready across frameworks including CMMC, FedRAMP 20x, NIST, SOC 2, and ISO 27001. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Accomplice, and In-Q-Tel.

basic_info.name: GrayviX
basic_info.description: GrayviX is a modern Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) and Security Automation platform developed and backed by GrayXploit.We help organizations simplify compliance, strengthen security, and manage risks through a centralized platform built for today's evolving regulatory and cybersecurity landscape.GrayviX enables businesses to streamline compliance processes, manage risk assessments, track security findings, organize audit evidence, automate repetitive workflows, and gain clear visibility into their security and compliance posture.Our platform integrates with 150+ security, cloud, DevOps, productivity, and business tools, allowing teams to connect their existing technology stack without disrupting operations.Beyond the platform, our experienced in-house cybersecurity professionals deliver penetration testing and practical remediation guidance, helping organizations identify vulnerabilities and strengthen their security posture with confidence.Whether you're preparing for compliance audits, improving governance, managing enterprise risks, or building a mature cybersecurity program, GrayviX provides the technology and expertise to support your journey.What We Do?• Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)• Risk Management & Risk Assessments• Compliance Management• Audit Readiness & Evidence Management• Policy & Document Management• Security Workflow Automation• Vulnerability Management• Expert-Led Penetration Testing• Remediation Support• 150+ Integrations• Centralized Dashboards & ReportingOur mission is to make governance, risk, compliance, and cybersecurity management simpler, faster, and more accessible helping organizations stay secure, audit-ready, and focused on growth.
